QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming
QuestInfo.0: After you delivered the time capsule to Chief Stan, he revealed that the childhood friend he buried it with later became his first wife. Her name was #bAnna#k. Sadly, she died young. \r\nThe chief, feeling guilty for reminiscing about the time they shared, asks you to keep all of this a secret from his current wife, #bMrs. Ming Ming#k.
